consumer: Unique Engine starts a distinct actual inspection attempt on the same physical item and exact inspection definition. It acquires actual resources and honors duration/preset cursor; pending-store item is not removed before its real check can start; hold-station handoff is atomic.
semantics: Reinspection performs a new check; it is not rework and does not increment completed_reworks. Previous completed attempt stays completed. UNKNOWN remains pending; actual rejected recheck follows declared finite-rework/isolation policy. It does not grant professional acknowledgment or manufacture a human decision.
state_and_storage: No new QualityDecision payload or independent quality state. Existing declared preset/human/provider source, exact refs, time, archive, frozen Scenario and event contracts remain.
wire_version: Existing API0.1/schema1.0 unchanged; all existing enum strings remain unchanged.
verification: Root Schema cases cover explicit reinspect and rejection of invented automatic_pass; actual Engine behavior is owned by W3 and independent W5 consumers, not inferred from type parsing.
